tool_input.command:
$f = "scripts\team\cycle.ps1"; $bak = "$env:TEMP\cycle.ps1.rec-bak"; Copy-Item $f $bak -Force
$before = (Get-FileHash $f -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; "before $before"
$bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f); $text = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
$m1 = $text.Replace('$runResearch = (-not $NoResearch) -or [bool]$ResearchOnly', '$runResearch = [bool]$Research -or [bool]$ResearchOnly')
if ($m1 -eq $text) { throw "m1 no change" }
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($f, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($m1))
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\tests\team-cycle.tests.ps1 -Filter "research is on by default" | Select-String "PASS|FAIL|team-cycle tests"
Copy-Item $bak $f -Force
"m1 restored $((Get-FileHash $f -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"
$m2 = $text.Replace('try { Send-TeamProposalApi -Store $apiStore', 'try { $null = $apiStore #')
if ($m2 -eq $text) { throw "m2 no change" }
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($f, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($m2))
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\tests\team-cycle.tests.ps1 -Filter "research is on by default: in API" | Select-String "PASS|FAIL|team-cycle tests"
Copy-Item $bak $f -Force
"m2 restored $((Get-FileHash $f -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"
